name: Black Mirror
body:
School divination; Level shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CAST

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, S, F (a dark mirror worth at least 1,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration see text

DESCRIPTION

You cast the spell and spend time gazing into the dark mirror. You see events that will unfold in the future but the mirror presents indistinct images and no direct context on time the events will occur. Each day thereafter when preparing or regaining your spells, you roll a d100 and if you roll higher than a 70, you gain the benefit for the day. Each day in which you roll under a 70, the number you must exceed decreases by 5, resetting to 70 on a success. Anytime during the day you may gain one of the following benefits:

Treat a skill check or attack roll as a natural 20. This does not count as a critical threat or allow you to gain the benefits only allowed to trained skill users.
Automatically succeed on a miss chance due to concealment– or displacement-like effects.
Know the location of creatures within 60 feet, even if you can’t sense them.
Treat a Reflex save as an automatic success.

Once you have used one of the benefits, you must wait until the next successful D100 roll to be able to use it again. You gain a number of successful uses of this spell equal to your spellcasting modifier before the spell expires. Multiple castings of this spell do not add additional uses of this spell, nor can you benefit from them concurrently. If the spell is cast again before the previous one expires, the number of successful uses resets.
